lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Renato | Lesson 1 -- New in the Line-Up

listenings.text: Hi Renato, it's Sue, your host mum. We're all really happy you're coming. So, quick information about the house. My name is Sue and my husband is Rob. We have two kids. Emma is sixteen and Jack is twelve. Our house is ten minutes from the beach, and the bus stop is right on the corner. Your room is small, but it's quiet. Oh, and one more thing. We're a very early family. Breakfast is at seven. See you soon, mate.

Right, listen up everyone. My name is Dave and I'm your coach this morning. The water is cold today, so the wetsuits are in the blue box behind me. The swell is small, about one metre, and that's perfect for a first session. Two rules. Rule one: you are never alone in the water. You are always with a partner. Rule two: if the flags are red, the beach is closed and nobody goes in. Any questions? No? Good. The boards are on the sand. Let's go.

items.situation: You are in the water on your first morning. A local paddles over and asks: "You're new, right?" Answer.
Somebody asks how long you are staying in Australia. Tell them.
The beach is full and you want to know if it is always like this. Ask.
Your host mum asks how you feel about the first day. Tell her the truth.
A friend from Brazil sends a message: "And the waves?" Answer in two sentences.
